visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In an animated setting, a girl with pink hair buns and a white shirt sits on a rug, reading a book. Beside her, a white cat with a unicorn horn sleeps peacefully. Outside the window, a stylized orange sunset glows behind a city skyline. (2) A small character in a yellow hoodie enters the frame, crouching and using their hands to create a 'frame' around the girl as if preparing to take a photo. (3) The girl reacts with extreme excitement, her eyes widening and glowing with stars as her cheeks blush red. She begins to strike a series of energetic and dramatic poses—laying on the floor, dancing, and posing with her hands behind her head—against a shifting background. (4) The yellow-hooded character holds a smartphone and takes multiple photos, indicated by white flashes and the girl's rapid movement. (5) The girl excitedly grabs the phone to check the results, but her expression instantly drops into a dark, gloomy, and disappointed frown as she stares at the screen. (6) A close-up of the smartphone shows a video playing where the unicorn cat is the central, clear subject in the foreground, while the pink-haired girl is just a tiny, blurred figure dancing far in the background. (7) The scene shifts to a dark, rainy night with lightning striking outside. The girl sits slumped on the floor, crying, surrounded by empty green bottles as the cat stands behind her. (8) A final graphic screen appears displaying a collection of character stickers with various captions.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo electronic synthesizer BGM starts with a cheerful melody. (2) A quick 'whoosh' sound effect occurs as a character appears. (3) A magical 'ding' or sparkle sound effect triggers when the character's eyes change. (4) A rapid sequence of mechanical camera shutter clicks fires as the visual shows photos being taken. (5) Fast swishing sound effects accompany the quick visual cuts of different poses. (6) A low-pitched, slightly dissonant dramatic sting sound plays to signal a mood shift. (7) A high-speed mechanical whirring sound, resembling a tape fast-forwarding, plays during the phone screen view. (8) A sharp thunderclap sound effect followed by the steady roar of falling rain and a faint, distant siren. (9) A final short, bright musical jingle ends the sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Setup -> Action -> Comic Twist -> Result -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To create a relatable comedic moment about the narcissism of social media photography vs. the reality of what people actually focus on (the pet), ultimately promoting a set of LINE stickers.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of a sticker set product page and brand logo at the end.
